templates.why_chosen: The DFG of operators, two round nodes, A into B, sits directly above the sTask-partition box as an inline glyph, then recurs as coloured A/B tiles through scheduling and hardware mapping.
templates.what_to_learn: Draw the operator graph as small circular nodes beside the stage that consumes it, keep one colour per operator (blue A, orange B) as it moves through partitioning and onto heterogeneous execution units, and close the loop with a labelled Profiling arrow feeding measurements back into an earlier stage.
